[You can access the private project (code, figures, explanations…) via this link](https://atphosphoshy2.private.cmaslard.xyz/). Access is restricted (Cloudflare Access). Use your authorized email to receive a one-time login code. If you don’t receive a code within \~60 seconds, your email is likely not allow-listed; please contact me.

AtPhosphoSHY2 is a private workspace for the integrated analysis and visualization of proteomic and phosphoproteomic data in *Arabidopsis thaliana*. Experimental details, intermediate results, and biological interpretations are intentionally omitted from this public page while the work remains unpublished.
